tools.name: stock_setup
tools.description: Report the resolved time zone, current time, which market is in effect (A-share or US), session phase, index list, brief windows, watchlist and account mode. Use it first when you are unsure what time the market clock is at.

summary.zh: 报时区、当前时间、市场状态、播报窗口、关注列表与账户模式。
summary.en: Reports the resolved clock, session phase, brief windows, watchlist and account mode.

tools.name: stock_now
tools.description: Fetch quotes for the watchlist (plus the configured index list) and return a briefing without pushing any event.

summary.zh: 立刻取一次行情并给出播报文案,不推送事件。
summary.en: Fetches quotes and returns a briefing without pushing an event.

tools.name: stock_brief
tools.description: Do a full briefing on demand: fetch quotes, push the stock.brief event, then the "want to see it?" follow-up. Same text the scheduled briefing would produce.

summary.zh: 完整播报一次:推 stock.brief 与追问事件。
summary.en: Runs a full briefing and pushes the brief and follow-up events.

tools.name: stock_watch
tools.description: Read or change the watchlist: list, add, remove, or set it outright. A-share codes and US index codes such as DJIA or NDX are both accepted.

symbols.description: Comma separated codes (600519, sz000001, DJIA); required for add, remove and set.

tools.name: stock_account
tools.description: Inspect or switch how your holdings are supplied: off, hand-filled, or a file exported from a broker. Never logs in anywhere.

file.description: For csv: absolute path of the exported holdings table.

summary.zh: 查看或切换持仓来源(关/手填/文件),不登录任何券商。
summary.en: Inspects or switches the holdings source; never logs in to a broker.

tools.name: stock_schedule
tools.description: Report the brief windows for the market in effect, what already fired today and when the next one is due.

summary.zh: 报播报窗口、今天播过几次、下一段什么时候。
summary.en: Reports brief windows, what fired today and when the next one is due.

description.zh: 挂载或跨日时先对表:报出时区、北京时间与市场状态。
description.en: On mount or on a new day, fixes the time zone, Beijing time and session phase.

description.zh: 收盘时段的涨跌播报,正文就是完整文案。
description.en: The closing-window briefing; its text is the whole message.

description.zh: 播报后的追问「请问(称呼),需要查看吗?」。
description.en: The follow-up question asked right after a briefing.

prompts.title: 拟股喵喵 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
拟股喵喵(stock)负责盯 {{stock.market}}:现在是 {{stock.now}},你那边 {{stock.zone}},市场状态 {{stock.phase}};大盘指数 {{stock.index}},关注列表 {{stock.watch}},账户数据 {{stock.account}}。

收盘时段会自动播报涨跌(时段一律按 {{stock.market}} 的交易所时区判定),播完会追问一句「请问{{stock.user}},需要查看吗?」——被追问时直接调用 stock_now 把行情拿出来,不要凭记忆复述旧数字。播报文案会按你的人格改写,但里面的价格与涨跌幅是真实行情,不要改动。

要改关注列表用 stock_watch,要看时区、生效市场与播报窗口用 stock_setup。
